summary: Static GPS-scope review with successful demo-only Firestore rules and authenticated browser regression in GitHub Actions run 40836424173 at 4aacebb. Merchant direct parent-order access remains denied; scoped server projection retained. No rules deploy or real-phone/staging verification. This score is not production certification.

findings.issue: Merchant view uses a scoped server projection with 10-second polling; client and administrator use document listeners. The UI explicitly states this delay.
findings.recommendation: Measure read volume in isolated staging; retain one open merchant map and do not widen direct rules for convenience.

findings.issue: GPS reports remain courier-device assertions, not cryptographic proof of real location. Browser background and best-effort cleanup limitations persist.
findings.recommendation: Validate with two real phones, permission loss and concurrent reassignment; never present absolute accuracy guarantees.
